title: Algo framework tester
author: Algoexperimentor
selftext:
Guys hey I recently completed my passion project which is a robust algo framework tester. 

I feel as though it is not just a backtest because it has a mutation-test and fuzz-machine test among other features to ensure complete functionality. 

I was just wondering if anyone could give me input on it check it out or what its completely open source and free. Just want to see some real input from people who actually use algorithms. Just want to see if I can help people.
